decisions.title: Cost-Conscious Development
decisions.decision: Prefer zero-cost workflows; paid infrastructure requires explicit owner approval and a documented justification.

decisions.title: Safe Database Migration Workflow
decisions.decision: Generate and review migration SQL by default; production execution requires explicit owner approval.

decisions.title: FRKS is a knowledge layer, not a competing constitution
decisions.decision: AEGIS remains the operational constitution; FRKS preserves and indexes knowledge and ADRs hold binding decisions.
